title: Chapter 42 A Terrifying War, Huang Shou Comes Out Of Retreat
content:
Chapter 42 A Terrifying War, Huang Shou Comes Out Of Retreat

Immediately afterwards, a huge battleship filled with terror slowly sailed from the void.

The material with mysterious light flowing on it knows that the warship is of great value.

I saw the words "Wild City" engraved on the flag on the battleship.

"It's Huangcheng, they are really here!"

When everyone saw the warship, they exclaimed immediately.

The next moment, the Lu family army led by Yun Qi stepped out of the warship and stood in the starry sky.

Seeing this million army, all the people on the border defense line were shocked and dropped.

This deserted city actually has such terrifying power.

However, this was not over yet, and Awei led the deserted guards to slowly walk out of the warship.

He was wearing a uniform outfit, with a long knife around his waist showing his sharpness.

Finally, there are the strong men who came voluntarily in the deserted city.

But without exception, everyone is united in hatred and glaring at the evil clan at the boundary of the universe.

"Everyone follows me and kill the alien race!"

Yun Qi roared angrily, and suddenly, the countless soldiers behind him began to roar wildly.

The momentum has reached its peak.

"Kill the alien race!"

On the border line, everyone was also inspired by this momentum, and a look of madness surged across their faces.

"Let these beasts see how powerful my Hongmeng Universe is!"

The next moment, the entire border line collapsed completely.

However, the evil demon could not see any fear in the eyes of the creatures in the Hongmeng universe. Instead, it was replaced by a murderous gaze.

In an instant, the demons felt something was wrong.

But the arrow has already come out of the string, so there is no reason to retreat.

"Run for me!"

In an instant, the two forces of the Hongmeng Universe creatures and the evil demon clan collided directly.

The entire border began to tremble continuously.

Countless black holes are constantly arising from the terrifying power.

However, facing the crushing of the number of evil demon clans, Hongmeng Universe quickly fell into a disadvantage.

Suddenly, Awei rushed up directly with Huang Wei.

"Don't forget, we are there."

In the dark, a faint sound came.

Suddenly, tens of thousands of powerful men appeared and kept harvesting their heads from the battlefield like killers.

With every dark light flash, an evil demon fell.

It is one of the most mysterious forces in the deserted city, the root.

However, the number of these killers and the Wilderness Guards was still too small in comparison to the countless evil demon clans. Soon, the evil demon clan relied on the human sea tactics to rush up again.

Behind, Gu Chen and Yun Qi saw this scene, they looked at each other and nodded.

The next moment, two terrifying pressure from the Reincarnation Realm soared into the sky from behind, and for a moment, the entire battlefield was stopped.

"This is the legendary powerful man in the Reincarnation Realm?!"

"Oh my God! I have a strong man in the Hongmeng Universe."

"Hahahaha, if the heavens don't destroy my Hongmeng universe!"

Suddenly, the strong men on the border were all excited.

Duan Heng looked at the scene in front of him with a bitter smile on his face.

"This deserted city has hidden me so miserably."

Facing the two powerful people in the Reincarnation Realm, the countless evil demons suddenly fell like cannon fodder.

For a moment, there was no evil demon in the entire Hongmeng universe.

Is it over?

Of course not.

Everyone stared at the crack, not daring to slacken at all.

Because they knew that this was just the first wave of offensives.

Sure enough, the boundaries of the universe, which had been silent for a moment, began to boil again.

Countless evil spirits with even more terrifying auras surged out from the border cracks.

"So many years have passed, and I didn't expect that such a strong man could appear in your small world."

The next moment, several terrifying evil demons stood on the starry sky, looking at the Hongmeng Universe with disdain.

Its aura is also the realm of reincarnation.

"It's the evil king!"

At this time, Old Yang spoke.

The six people that Xuan King fought against back then were such existences.

At this time, there were as many as ten evil demon king-level existences in the starry sky.

The gap in strength is too great.

The powerful men at the border line suddenly looked extremely ugly.

If they were the only one here, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Looking at the increasing evil demons in the starry sky, Old Yang took a deep breath and then said in a deep voice: "They should wake up too."

Suddenly, everyone looked shocked and nodded.

Old Yang rushed into the starry sky and shouted: "Seniors, Hongmeng Universe is in trouble, please help us through this disaster!"

As soon as he finished speaking, the entire starry sky suddenly began to tremble.

Everyone in Huangcheng also looked at all this with different expressions.

A light appeared in Gu Chen and Yun Qi's eyes.

Sure enough, it is impossible that only these guys here guard the boundaries of the universe, otherwise it would be too unbearable.

There was a loud bang.

That was the sound of the coffin board flying up.

"Those who offend my Hongmeng Universe will be punished even if they are far away!"

With an angry roar, countless strong people rushed here from the void.

Each one has a terrifying breath.

At the lowest point, they are the existence of the state of cause and effect.

Among them, there are even realms of life and death, and there are three existences in the realm of reincarnation.

However, without exception, these strong men have almost exhausted their lives and can only live longer with endless sleep, for the sake of today's battle.

This is their real trump card.

"kill!"

These strong men did not talk too much nonsense, they all rushed towards the evil demon.

Because they have little life span, they may die suddenly while fighting.

But they were extremely brave and defeated the evil demons and the powerful men, because they were desperate for life when they fought.

"Go together!"

Yun Qi and others immediately took their subordinates to charge towards the evil demon clan.

Seeing that Hongmeng Universe had the advantage, the evil demon clan was extremely angry.

"Okay, very good, you have completely angered my clan."

"Let you see the horror of my evil devil clan."

The next moment, more than a dozen demon king-level existences rushed out from the cracks in the boundary of the universe.

At the same time, the number of low-level evil demons began to soar at a speed of geometric times.

Seeing this scene, all the people in the Hongmeng Universe looked ugly.

They even had the idea of not killing them at all.

So many, how can I fight this?

Just as everyone was completely disappointed, countless auras suddenly surged out from behind.

"The Great Yan Sect fell down and came to help!"

"The God King Palace comes to help!"

"And my Haoyue Sect comes to help!"

......

For a time, more than a dozen powerful forces came from all over the Hongmeng Universe to help.

Seeing this scene, Old Yang was already in tears.

"My Hongmeng Universe is indeed united!"

"Hahaha, it's a good time!"

With the addition of these forces, the Hongmeng Universe was greatly encouraged and its morale increased greatly, and it moved back a little.

However, the top-level high-end combat power is still lacking.

Even though Gu Chen and Yun Qi both competed with each other, there were still several evil demon kings who were not restrained, causing heavy losses to the people on their side.

"Hmph, no matter how many people come to your Hongmeng Universe, you will be able to end up failing."

"It's better to make our tribe's on-the-trade meal honestly, hehehe."

Looking at the disgusting faces of the demon clan, everyone looked heavy.

Did you really stop here?

That is certainly impossible.

Just when the scene was at its most intense, a blood-colored sword suddenly came quickly from the depths of the void, and wherever it passed, the space was cut open.

"I wonder if your evil demon clan can take this sword."

laugh!

With one sword, millions of evil demons flew high, and the black blood instantly dyed the entire starry sky.

"It's Senior Huang!"

When they left the pass, they did not see Huang Shou.

They were still a little confused at first, but now it seems that Huang Shou's strength has broken through to a point that is even more terrifying than the realm of reincarnation.

That's right, because Huang Shouzheng was at a critical moment of breakthrough at that time, Lu Daosheng did not call Huang Shou out of the world in his palm.

Sure enough, behind everyone, Huang Shou slowly came towards here from the void.

Behind him are Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing.

At this moment, Ouyang Yanqing looked at Huang Shou with extremely complicated eyes.

Once upon a time, she and Huang Shou were of the same level.

And now, Huang Shou has left her ten streets.

All of this is because of choice.

I knew that when I saw Lu Daosheng, I should have followed Lu Daosheng directly.

Otherwise, I will not be like this now.

In the dark, Lu Daosheng looked at the battlefield with relief in his eyes.

"It's still the strongest in my deserted city."
